name: Shree Suvarna Temple
description:
DAILY AARTI TIMINGS - (Morning 9:00 am
Afternoon 12:30 pm
Night 9:00 pm)
Suvarna Temple is also known as "Shree Mahashesha Rundamalini Temple" or "Nine Mother Children Temple" and is indeed a unique temple in its own. Located amidst the beauty of Powai this temple has lot of serenity and calm. The ‘Nine Mother Children’ temple is one of the oldest holy places in Powai. This temple was evolved in 1957, but the prathista and other ritual ceremony were performed on 1963. Here you can find all the almighties from all the communities-Hindus, Muslim, Chirstian. So the restriction is not imparted on any caste to enter inside the premises. Here all the caste and religion are treated one and the same.

featured_reviews.name: arti mogadpally
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting the Suvarna Naga Temple in Powai was a deeply peaceful and spiritually uplifting experience. Tucked away amidst greenery and the calm surroundings of Powai, the temple offers a soothing escape from the noise and rush of city life. As soon as I entered the temple premises, I felt a sense of serenity and positive energy.
The temple is dedicated to Lord Suvarna Naga, and the idol is beautifully adorned, reflecting devotion and purity. The architecture is simple yet graceful, allowing devotees to focus entirely on prayer and meditation. The priests perform the rituals with great dedication, and they patiently guide devotees through the puja process, explaining its significance.
What touched me the most was the calm atmosphere inside the temple. The sound of bells, chants, and incense created a spiritually charged environment that helped me feel connected and grounded. Many devotees visit the temple seeking relief from Naga dosha and for overall well-being, and the faith here feels strong and genuine.
Overall, my visit to Suvarna Naga Temple, Powai, was a fulfilling experience. It left me with inner peace, positivity, and a sense of gratitude. I would highly recommend this temple to anyone looking for spiritual solace and divine blessings in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.review_text: One of the highlight of my recent trip to India was visit to Shree Padmavati temple in IIT Bombay.

featured_reviews.name: JYOTI MAHAJAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Padmavati Devi Temple is a शांत और बहुत ही सुंदर मंदिर located inside the green and peaceful campus of Indian Institute of Technology Bombay. Surrounded by trees and calm vibes, this temple offers a perfect escape from the busy life of Mumbai.

The temple is dedicated to Goddess Padmavati, and the atmosphere here feels very positive and relaxing. It’s not as crowded as other famous temples, which makes the darshan experience smooth and peaceful. Students and visitors often come here to sit quietly, pray, or just spend some time in silence.

featured_reviews.name: Sayali Raut
featured_reviews.review_text: This place offers a truly holistic experience! ✨ Just remember, an entry pass is required to access the main gate. 🙏 It's worth it! 😊

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is so peaceful, and the eyes of maa padmawati are so pretty.. I feel like drowing into them.. the place is cool, in the laptop of nature, at the bank of powai lake..

featured_reviews.name: Raman Thukral
featured_reviews.review_text: Well a very old temple in IIT Bombay premises it is dedicated to Mata Parvati. A relatively quite place situated among the intellectuals the beautiful scenery due to it being situated on the bank of Powai lake is mesmerising. A must visit if you ever visit IIT Bombay. Even the way to the temple goes along the bank of the lake.

featured_reviews.name: Ravi Bisht
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Padmavati Devi Temple, nestled within the serene IIT Bombay campus, is more than just a place of worship, it's a testament to the harmonious blend of tradition and modernity. This ancient temple, offers a unique spiritual experience amidst the bustling academic environment.
Dedicated to Goddess Padmavati, an incarnation of Lakshmi, the temple is a popular pilgrimage site for students, faculty, and local residents. Daily prayers and special rituals are conducted, fostering a sense of community and devotion.
The temple plays a vital role in the cultural life of the IIT Bombay community. It hosts various religious and festive events throughout the year, attracting students. These celebrations provide an opportunity for students to connect with their cultural roots and experience the rich tapestry of Hindu traditions.
In the midst of the demanding academic environment, the Padmavati Devi Temple serves as a haven of peace and tranquility. It offers a space for introspection, meditation, and spiritual rejuvenation. Whether you are seeking solace, seeking blessings, or simply admiring the architectural beauty, the temple offers a unique and enriching experience.
Whether you are a student, faculty member, or a visitor to the IIT Bombay campus, a visit to the Padmavati Devi Temple is highly recommended. It is a place where tradition meets modernity, where spirituality intertwines with academic pursuits, and where one can find solace and inspiration in the midst of a bustling metropolis.
जय माता दी ।
